title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: No behaviour changes. Seven tests meant to protect the last eight releases turned out to prove nothing, and now do.

highlights.title: Tests That Now Hold
highlights.description: Each test was checked by breaking the code it claims to cover. Seven did not notice. They cover inline folding, the per line state that survives a deletion, and three comment block guards.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Nothing changes in what the extension does today. What changes is what a future edit is allowed to break in silence.

The inline folding rewrite from 1.42.191 was re examined on the real project: none of its 30 403 folds lands inside a comment or a raw string, while a deliberately broken build produces 1 440 that do.
